scripts.name: Prepare Hermes worktree
scripts.command: if [ -n "${T3CODE_WORKTREE_PATH:-}" ] && [ -n "${T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT:-}" ] && [ "$T3CODE_WORKTREE_PATH" != "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT" ] && [ -d service-bursawatch-control ] && [ -f "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/service-bursawatch-control/.env" ]; then if [ -e service-bursawatch-control/.env ] || [ -L service-bursawatch-control/.env ]; then echo "refusing to replace existing service-bursawatch-control/.env" >&2; exit 1; fi; ln -s "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/service-bursawatch-control/.env" service-bursawatch-control/.env; fi
